## Change

Describe the narrow artifact, code, or documentation change.

## Reproduction

List the exact commands run and the observed result.

## Rights and provenance

- [ ] New external material includes its source and reuse basis.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, customer data, restricted review material, or non-public outputs are included.

## Claim boundary

- [ ] The change does not broaden a claim beyond the committed evidence.
- [ ] `python scripts/audit_public_artifact.py` passes.
